source_documents.title: Understanding the aggregation induced emission enhancement for a compound with excited state intramolecular proton transfer character

reference_evidence_units.quote: no enol but only ESIPT emission was observed.
reference_evidence_units.subject: BTHPB
reference_evidence_units.conditions: BTHPB dilute solution and water aggregates, 10^-5 M, 360 nm steady-state excitation; cyclohexane/paraffin viscosity control, 355 nm flash photolysis, 360 nm femtosecond pump-probe in THF or polystyrene.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Water aggregates and cyclohexane show only the approximately 509 nm keto/ESIPT band, unlike polar solvents that also show approximately 400 nm enol emission.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: State assignment is spectroscopic; aggregation is not assumed to give unit ESIPT yield.

reference_evidence_units.quote: The luminescent quantum eﬃciency of BTHPB aggregates was as high as 0.27
reference_evidence_units.subject: BTHPB
reference_evidence_units.conditions: BTHPB dilute solution and water aggregates, 10^-5 M, 360 nm steady-state excitation; cyclohexane/paraffin viscosity control, 355 nm flash photolysis, 360 nm femtosecond pump-probe in THF or polystyrene.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Quantum yield increases from 0.018 in cyclohexane to 0.27 in water aggregates, with lifetime increasing from 0.23 to 7.0 ns.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Approximately 15-fold yield versus 30-fold lifetime increase is crucial; these are not interchangeable enhancement metrics.

reference_evidence_units.quote: the excited state of cis-keto was the form without intramolecular charge transfer character.
reference_evidence_units.subject: BTHPB
reference_evidence_units.conditions: BTHPB dilute solution and water aggregates, 10^-5 M, 360 nm steady-state excitation; cyclohexane/paraffin viscosity control, 355 nm flash photolysis, 360 nm femtosecond pump-probe in THF or polystyrene.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Nearly unchanged ESIPT emission energy and shape with solvent polarity argues against ICT for the cis-keto emitting state.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Negative result limited to the keto emission assignment, not all possible electronic polarization.

reference_evidence_units.quote: The emission quantum eﬃciency of BTHPB in paraﬃn oil (80% volume ratio) was calculated as 0.050
reference_evidence_units.subject: BTHPB
reference_evidence_units.conditions: BTHPB dilute solution and water aggregates, 10^-5 M, 360 nm steady-state excitation; cyclohexane/paraffin viscosity control, 355 nm flash photolysis, 360 nm femtosecond pump-probe in THF or polystyrene.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Raising viscosity with 80% paraffin oil increases yield to 0.050 while absorption stays similar.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Solvent control supports restricted torsion but cannot alone locate the principal nonradiative coordinate; source's aggregate viscosity is only an estimate.

reference_evidence_units.quote: with large reorganization energy corresponded to rotation around the bond
reference_evidence_units.subject: BTHPB
reference_evidence_units.conditions: BTHPB dilute solution and water aggregates, 10^-5 M, 360 nm steady-state excitation; cyclohexane/paraffin viscosity control, 355 nm flash photolysis, 360 nm femtosecond pump-probe in THF or polystyrene.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Linear-coupling TDDFT/B3LYP analysis assigns the 19 cm^-1 mode to inter-subunit rotation; Table 1 gives Huang-Rhys factor 13.12 and reorganization energy 245 cm^-1.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Harmonic qualitative model. Other high-frequency modes contribute substantial reorganization energy; the rotational contribution is not the only possible IC mode.

reference_evidence_units.quote: These decay kinetics were insensitive to the presence of oxygen and thus could not be assigned to a triplet state.
reference_evidence_units.subject: BTHPB
reference_evidence_units.conditions: BTHPB dilute solution and water aggregates, 10^-5 M, 360 nm steady-state excitation; cyclohexane/paraffin viscosity control, 355 nm flash photolysis, 360 nm femtosecond pump-probe in THF or polystyrene.
reference_evidence_units.statement: The long-lived 400-500 nm cyclohexane transient is oxygen-insensitive and assigned to a trans-keto photoproduct rather than a triplet.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Assignment uses oxygen response and analogy. PDF text mangles the microsecond symbol; Figure 4 visually checked, no exact lifetime inferred beyond the source's approximate estimate.

reference_evidence_units.quote: In the aggregates, however, no transient absorption signals were detected
reference_evidence_units.subject: BTHPB
reference_evidence_units.conditions: BTHPB dilute solution and water aggregates, 10^-5 M, 360 nm steady-state excitation; cyclohexane/paraffin viscosity control, 355 nm flash photolysis, 360 nm femtosecond pump-probe in THF or polystyrene.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Flash-photolysis photoproduct absorption detected in solution is not detected in aggregates, supporting blocked inter-subunit rotation.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Detection-limited absence, not literal proof of zero photoproduct.

reference_evidence_units.quote: a polystyrene matrix instead of cyclohexane and aggregates (bad signal/noise ratio), respectively
reference_evidence_units.subject: BTHPB
reference_evidence_units.conditions: BTHPB dilute solution and water aggregates, 10^-5 M, 360 nm steady-state excitation; cyclohexane/paraffin viscosity control, 355 nm flash photolysis, 360 nm femtosecond pump-probe in THF or polystyrene.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Femtosecond comparison substitutes THF and polystyrene for cyclohexane and aggregates; the 440-500 nm trans-keto band is absent in the solid matrix.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Polystyrene is a proxy, not the same water-aggregate sample. Figure 5 visually inspected; source reports approximately 40 ps cis-keto decay in THF.

reference_evidence_units.quote: suggesting that the aggregation process induced the decrease of the ESIPT yield.
reference_evidence_units.subject: BTHPB
reference_evidence_units.conditions: BTHPB dilute solution and water aggregates, 10^-5 M, 360 nm steady-state excitation; cyclohexane/paraffin viscosity control, 355 nm flash photolysis, 360 nm femtosecond pump-probe in THF or polystyrene.
reference_evidence_units.statement: The source infers about a factor-two lower ESIPT formation yield in aggregates from the unequal yield/lifetime enhancements.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Depends on assuming equal keto radiative rates from similar spectra; ESIPT yields were not directly measured.

reference_evidence_units.quote: resulted from the strong intermolecular interactions of the enol forms
reference_evidence_units.subject: BTHPB
reference_evidence_units.conditions: BTHPB dilute solution and water aggregates, 10^-5 M, 360 nm steady-state excitation; cyclohexane/paraffin viscosity control, 355 nm flash photolysis, 360 nm femtosecond pump-probe in THF or polystyrene.
reference_evidence_units.statement: The authors propose an opposing aggregation-induced loss before keto formation, while rotational restriction improves keto fluorescence.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Competing ultrafast route is explicitly unclear; ordinary Forster diffusion is argued against. No specific J aggregate, excimer, or measured electron transfer is established.

reference_mechanisms.label: RIM_RIR_RIV
reference_mechanisms.rationale: Viscosity, a low-frequency rotational mode and suppressed trans-keto photoproduct support the authors' main rotational-restriction explanation.

reference_mechanisms.label: PACKING_HOST_MATRIX_CONFINEMENT
reference_mechanisms.rationale: Aggregate/matrix physical constraints suppress rotation, while intermolecular interactions may introduce a competing loss pathway.

reference_mechanisms.label: ESIPT_PT
reference_mechanisms.rationale: Keto emission follows ESIPT, whose yield is not assumed to be 100%; a proposed decrease opposes the net enhancement.

reference_mechanisms.label: RADIATIVE_RATE_STATE_BALANCE
reference_mechanisms.rationale: Source explicitly separates keto-state formation yield and fluorescence survival; the factor-two ESIPT-yield estimate is conditional on unchanged radiative rate.

mechanism_decisions.label: RIM_RIR_RIV
mechanism_decisions.rationale: Viscosity, a low-frequency rotational mode and suppressed trans-keto photoproduct support the authors' main rotational-restriction explanation.

mechanism_decisions.label: PACKING_HOST_MATRIX_CONFINEMENT
mechanism_decisions.rationale: Aggregate/matrix physical constraints suppress rotation, while intermolecular interactions may introduce a competing loss pathway.

mechanism_decisions.label: HOST_GUEST_INTERACTION
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No guest binding, pore uptake or host inclusion mechanism is established; a solvent or self-assembly is not automatically host-guest chemistry.

mechanism_decisions.label: ICT_TICT_CT
mechanism_decisions.rationale: The authors argue that cis-keto emission lacks ICT character from its weak solvent dependence.

mechanism_decisions.label: ESIPT_PT
mechanism_decisions.rationale: Keto emission follows ESIPT, whose yield is not assumed to be 100%; a proposed decrease opposes the net enhancement.

mechanism_decisions.label: PET_ET
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No photoinduced electron-transfer quenching or turn-on is established; energy transfer and CT character are not by themselves PET.

mechanism_decisions.label: AGGREGATE_EXCITON_EXCIMER
mechanism_decisions.rationale: The negative intermolecular effect is an unspecified competing route, not a demonstrated exciton/J-aggregate/excimer mechanism.

mechanism_decisions.label: RADIATIVE_RATE_STATE_BALANCE
mechanism_decisions.rationale: Source explicitly separates keto-state formation yield and fluorescence survival; the factor-two ESIPT-yield estimate is conditional on unchanged radiative rate.

mechanism_decisions.label: TRIPLET_METAL_ENERGY_TRANSFER
mechanism_decisions.rationale: The observed long-lived species is assigned to trans-keto rather than triplet; no operative triplet mechanism established.

mechanism_decisions.label: RACI_CI_ACCESS
mechanism_decisions.rationale: Restricted rotation and photoproduct suppression are demonstrated, but this paper does not locate or specifically assign a target CI.

mechanism_decisions.label: SOKR_ANTI_KASHA
mechanism_decisions.rationale: The source states high excited levels relax to the same lowest excited state; no higher-state emission is established.
